title: Becky Sayler
description: Sayler voted against terminating a teacher who read a divisive book about gender identity to her elementary students, reportedly against Georgia divisive concepts law.
body:
# Becky Sayler

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/08/Sayler_cropped.jpg)

- Sayler [voted against](https://web.archive.org/web/20240206191057/https:/eu.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2023/08/18/georgia-teacher-fired-for-teaching-about-gender-fluidity/70619955007/) terminating a teacher who read a divisive book about gender identity to her elementary students, reportedly against Georgia divisive concepts law.
- Regarding the teacher reading the book about gender identity aloud to elementary children, [Sayler said](https://web.archive.org/web/20240206191057/https:/eu.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2023/08/18/georgia-teacher-fired-for-teaching-about-gender-fluidity/70619955007/), “To all the parents concerned that it’s too hard to hear about a child who does not feel they fit in as a boy or a girl, I would challenge you to consider how difficult it is to be the child who doesn’t fit in,” Sayler wrote. “As a community, let’s do what we can to tell that child they belong.”
